datasetVintage: BIS consolidated banking statistics bulk CSV, last updated 2026-09-14

filter.reporters: EU27 country reporting-bank groups, individually summed only where available
filter.basis: separately report all published basis codes; no pooling across basis

limitations: BIS reports country-level banking-system aggregates, not individual institutions or bank-country bilateral exposures for each EU member in one consolidated EU jurisdiction.
Summed public reporter values are lower-bound coverage if reporter-level observations are unavailable/confidential; missing values are not zero.
CBS is worldwide consolidated banking groups headquartered in reporter country, excludes intragroup positions. Basis definitions differ and are kept separate.
All-sector total claims are not sovereign-only exposures; no private, public, direct/portfolio investment added from these bank claim series.
The latest BIS bulk vintage retrieved 2026-09-14 observes Q1 2026, not Q2 2026.

summaryRows.interpretation: Sum of published non-missing EU27-country reporter-group observations only; partial coverage lower bound for these reported positions, not an EU-wide consolidated total. Missing/confidential observations are not assumed zero.

scopeNote: BIS consolidated banking statistics record internationally consolidated reporting banking groups by home reporter country and counterparty. They exclude intra-group positions and are not a complete measure of all euro-area or EU investor exposures. EU27 reporter sums are partial; coverage differs by counterparty and basis. All-sector claims are gross claims, not net positions or loss estimates.
